Content: “Free should the scholar be, - free and brave... We have listened too long to the courtly muses of Europe... We will walk on our own feet; we will work with our own hands; we will speak our own minds. Then shall man be no longer a name for pity, for doubt, and for sensual indulgence... A nation of men will for the `text(first)` time exist.”
